name: 90-Minute Wake Window
title: Keep wake time within a 90-minute window.
benefit: Better sleep and steadier energy across the week.
subtitle: Sleep Timing
rationale: Reducing large swings in wake time matters more than precision when the current pattern is chaotic.

evidence.summary: Reducing day-to-day variation in sleep and wake timing supports circadian stability and health.

sources.label: Sleep timing and consistency systematic review

indications: Wake time swings by hours between weekdays and weekends.
Social jet lag leaves Mondays wrecked.
Sleep duration is adequate but timing is chaotic.
